description: This file defines a Java interface named AdapterResolver, which declares a method for resolving the appropriate Adapter for a given Adaptable object in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project.

classes.name: AdapterResolver
classes.description: An interface that declares a method to determine the correct Adapter for a given Adaptable object, facilitating conversion to a Signal.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Abstract method that, given an Adaptable, returns an Adapter capable of converting it into a Signal.
